Prabhācandra

On the basis of the colophon to his C. on Parīkṣāmukha he is taken to be a contemporary of Bhojadeva an. hence a. belonging to the 11th Cent. See BORI. D. XVIII. i. 66 (colophon: zrImadbhojadevarAjye zrImaddhArAnivAsinI …prabhAcandreNa paNDitena etc.). But he an. his work Nyāyakumudacandrodaya are mentioned by Jinasena in Ādipurāṇa (9th Cent.). Hence he is placed prior to 9th Cent. See Intro. p. xliii to edn. of Parīkṣāmukha, Sac. Bk.. of the Jainas XI. Lucknow, 1940. Contemporary of Pātrakesari. On Śāntarakṣita, Kamalaśīla an.
